subject: UPS input breaker interrupting rating below spec
question: Vendor's standard UPS input breaker package is rated 65kAIC. Spec 26 33 00 requires 100kAIC given the coordinated fault current study. Confirm whether the 65kAIC breaker is acceptable with a current-limiting fuse ahead of it, or whether the 100kAIC factory option must be ordered.
resolution: EOR rejected current-limiting fuse workaround due to selective coordination concerns with upstream switchgear relaying. Contractor ordered 100kAIC factory option; added 9 weeks to UPS fabrication lead time.

subject: Battery runtime shortfall on submitted UPS
question: Submitted VRLA battery string provides 7 minutes at full load; spec requires 10 minutes minimum autonomy to bridge to generator start. Vendor proposes reducing to two-step load transfer to compensate. Is this acceptable?
resolution: EOR rejected the two-step transfer workaround (adds complexity and a new failure mode). Contractor resubmitted with expanded battery cabinet meeting 10-minute requirement.

subject: Dry-type transformer impedance outside coordination study tolerance
question: Manufacturer's standard 2500kVA cast-coil transformer has 7% impedance. Spec basis-of-design assumed 5.75% for the short-circuit and protective coordination study. Does the 7% value require a revised coordination study, or is it within acceptable tolerance?
resolution: EOR confirmed 7% falls outside the +/-7.5% tolerance band on 5.75% nominal (5.32-6.18% acceptable). Required custom low-impedance wind; EOR re-ran arc-flash and coordination study at contractor's cost for the delay incurred.

subject: Refrigerant substitution on precision cooling units
question: Spec requires low-GWP R-454B refrigerant per sustainability addendum. Vendor's quoted lead time is 8 weeks shorter for standard R-410A units. Can Owner accept R-410A with a future retrofit commitment?
resolution: Owner rejected retrofit-later proposal citing state HFC phase-down compliance risk and warranty concerns on field refrigerant conversion. Contractor accepted 8-week lead time adder for factory R-454B units.

subject: Medium voltage switchgear short-circuit withstand below fault study
question: Standard 15kV switchgear frame offered by vendor has 25kA/3-sec withstand rating. Project fault current study shows 34.6kA available at the bus. Spec requires 40kA minimum. Can the 25kA frame be accepted with current-limiting reactors added upstream?
resolution: EOR rejected reactor workaround (adds voltage drop and a maintenance item not in original design intent). Contractor ordered upgraded 40kA frame; 6-week lead time adder absorbed within existing procurement float, no schedule impact to overall milestone.

subject: Generator standby rating below spec minimum
question: Vendor's standard frame for the requested engine model is rated 1200ekW standby. Spec requires 1250kW minimum. Is the 1200ekW unit acceptable given it is within 4% of spec?
resolution: EOR rejected on the basis that N+1 redundancy sizing was calculated against the 1250kW figure; a 4% shortfall across all units reduces the effective redundancy margin below the design basis. Contractor upsized to next frame.

subject: Conflicting transfer switch timing requirements between spec sections
question: Section 26 36 00 specifies 4-cycle max transfer time for critical ATS units. Section 26 05 00 paragraph 3.4.C references a 10-cycle allowance tied to NFPA 99 essential electrical systems, which appears to be inherited from a healthcare project template. Which governs for this data center project?
resolution: EOR confirmed 26 36 00 (4-cycle) governs; 26 05 00 3.4.C was a template carryover not applicable to this project type and was struck via addendum.

subject: Concrete pour delay due to rebar submittal rejection
question: Structural rebar submittal was rejected for non-conforming splice detailing. Can the Contractor proceed with the pour using field corrections pending resubmittal approval?
resolution: Rejected; full resubmittal and approval required prior to pour per QA/QC hold point.

subject: Fire suppression agent substitution
question: Vendor proposes substituting clean agent FK-5-1-12 for the specified FM-200 due to supply chain constraints. Confirm acceptability.
resolution: Accepted with revised discharge calculations and updated room integrity test.

subject: BMS point list mismatch with CRAC controller
question: Submitted CRAC unit's native BACnet point list omits three alarm points required by the BMS integration spec. How should this be resolved?
resolution: Vendor to provide gateway mapping to synthesize missing points from available raw sensor data; verified during Level 4 commissioning.

subject: Busway rating clarification for UPS output distribution
question: Confirm busway ampacity requirement downstream of 750kW UPS modules operating at 480V.
resolution: Confirmed 1200A busway per calculated full-load current with 25% NEC continuous-load margin.

subject: Cable tray fill exceeding NEC allowance in shared electrical corridor
question: As-built cable tray routing shows fill exceeding 40% in the shared MV/LV corridor. Remediation options?
resolution: Added parallel tray run; re-routed non-critical low-voltage control cabling.

subject: Generator paralleling switchgear relay coordination with utility protection
question: Utility requires reverse power protection setting that conflicts with generator manufacturer's default relay curve during black-start testing. Recommend resolution path.
resolution: Custom relay curve developed jointly with utility and generator OEM; verified during Level 5 IST black-start simulation.

subject: Chilled water pipe insulation thickness below spec in mechanical yard
question: Field-installed insulation on chilled water supply/return piping measures 1 inch; spec requires 1.5 inch minimum for the climate zone. Remediation?
resolution: Contractor added supplemental insulation wrap to meet 1.5in minimum; verified by thermal imaging survey.

subject: Raised floor grounding grid resistance test failure
question: Ground resistance test at raised floor pedestal grid measured 8 ohms; spec requires 5 ohms maximum. Options for remediation without full regrounding?
resolution: Added supplemental ground rods at high-resistance zones; retest confirmed 4.2 ohms.

subject: Arc flash label discrepancy after transformer impedance change
question: Following the transformer impedance resubmittal (RFI-HIST-003 on prior project, similar condition here), do arc flash labels need to be reissued before energization?
resolution: Yes -- arc flash study and labels reissued to reflect as-built impedance prior to any energized work.

subject: CRAC unit sound level exceeding equipment yard limit
question: Submitted CRAC unit sound data shows 82 dB(A) at 10m; local ordinance and spec cap at 78 dB(A). Acceptable mitigations?
resolution: Vendor added acoustic louver package reducing measured level to 76 dB(A); verified during SAT.

subject: Long-lead switchgear delivery delay notification
question: Vendor notifies 6-week delay on MV switchgear delivery due to component shortage. Does this affect the critical path given current float?
resolution: Schedule analysis showed 11 weeks of float remaining on the switchgear chain at time of notice; 6-week delay absorbed with 5 weeks float remaining, no milestone impact. Documented for record only.

subject: Lithium-ion battery UL 9540A test report request
question: Submitted UPS battery cabinets use lithium-ion chemistry per Section 26 33 00.3 Contractor's option. AHJ is requesting UL 9540A large-scale fire test report prior to permit sign-off. Vendor has not provided this. How to proceed?
resolution: Vendor provided UL 9540A test report for the specific cabinet configuration; AHJ approved with required separation distances per report.

subject: Integrated systems test failure -- generator-to-UPS transfer sequencing
question: During Level 5 IST, simulated utility loss showed UPS depleting to 2 minutes remaining before generator breaker closed, versus the expected 30-second transfer window. Root cause?
resolution: Root cause: generator start-signal relay logic had an unintended 90-second debounce timer left at commissioning-vendor default. Corrected in EMCP4 controller; IST re-run and passed. Cited as a textbook commissioning-stage integration failure similar to industry-documented breaker-coordination incidents.
